Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change alters 3D Pocket cut levels and posted G-code.

What looks good (for the `#2088` shallow-floor change):
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/floor_levels.rs:9-38` adds flat upward floor heights plus `stock_to_leave` strictly between `first` and `top_z`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs:118,202,326,348` routes plain, offset-shell, open-side, air-split, avoid, and coarse/rest generation through `floor_levels::cut_levels`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining3d/floor_levels.rs:32-36` refuses pass counts above `limit` (`zs.len().max(MAX_PASSES as usize)`) by name.
- `crates/motion/tests/blind_floor.rs:184-286` pins shallow blind floors, `stock_to_leave`, top stock passes, pass-budget refusal, and keeps all 384 no-gouge and verify assertions active.
- `docs/decisions/2088-shallow-floor-levels.md` records the decision, rationale, alternatives, and cost to change later.
- The PR body states `Process change: yes` for the inherited `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` edit and does not change `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No `.nc`, `.cl`, or snapshot `.png` files change relative to `upstream/main`.

Results on the unchanged PR head (`3d2ed2122`):
The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`409c0b5ab`) conflicted in `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, and `crates/app/src/project/mod.rs`. I aborted the merge and ran all checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2678` on the unchanged PR head. This review used no GitHub runner.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base e11845b0c` (with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`): 36 steps passed, 0 failed.
  - `motion lib`: 434 passed, 10 ignored.
  - `motion` suites: `blind_floor` 5, `center_cut_law` 6, `engagement_3d` 3, `entry_approach` 9, `entry_arc` 12, `entry_arc_3d` 3, `islands_model_fault` 2, `level_links` 12, `machining3d` 23, `multiaxis_avoid` 6, `multiaxis_rough` 5, `offset_shells` 6 (1 ignored), `one_descent` 4, `optimal_load` 4, `pivot5d` 7 (1 ignored), `pocket_refusal` 3, `pocket3d_hsm` 3 (1 ignored), `pocket3d_mask_edge` 6, `posed_subtract` 1, `radial_step` 6, `refusal_ghost` 3, `rotary_adaptive` 3 (3 ignored), `stock_seam` 1, `top_z_level` 13.
  - `app` suites: `do_not_touch` 3, `first_router_part` 4, `operations` 120 (6 ignored), `pocket3d_open_side` 7, `project_roundtrip` 73, `remachining` 6, `roughing2d` 7, `shared_face_bodies` 5, `shared_face_bodies_finish` 2 (6 ignored).
- `camcraft-motion --test avoid_pocket`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-sim --lib`: 188 passed, 0 failed; `--test verify_avoid`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app --lib`: 372 passed (1 ignored), 0 failed; `--test blind_floor`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd `crates/ui`): 1205 passed (7 ignored), 0 failed; `--test boundary`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: planned 611 steps (not executed).

Repeated mutation checks in `crates/motion` (`--test blind_floor`):
1. Restore the four `cut_levels` calls in `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs:118,202,326,348` to `cut_levels_under`: 4 of 5 tests failed (`a_blind_hole_shallower_than_one_stepdown_is_cut_at_its_floor`, `a_shallow_floor_keeps_stock_allowance_and_the_top_stock_level`, `excessive_shallow_floor_levels_are_refused_by_name`, `a_blind_pocket_never_enters_solid_under_any_ladder`). After restoration: 5 passed, 0 failed.
2. Remove `+ p.stock_to_leave` at `crates/motion/src/machining3d/floor_levels.rs:23`: `a_shallow_floor_keeps_stock_allowance_and_the_top_stock_level` failed at `crates/motion/tests/blind_floor.rs:213:13`. After restoration: 5 passed, 0 failed.

I reverted both mutations. The worktree has no source edits left.

Requested before merge:
1. **`crates/app/src/project/file.rs:143`, `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs:534`, `crates/app/src/project/mod.rs:1`, and `crates/sim/src/verify/avoid.rs:150,170-174`: Resolve the merge conflicts and update the stacked `#2149` base.**
   This PR targets `main` while stacked on an older head (`e11845b0c`) of unmerged PR `#2149`. The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`409c0b5ab`) fails in the three project files because `file.rs:143` writes `PROJECT_VERSION = 71`, while `upstream/main` already uses `71` and `72`. The older `#2149` base also lacks `#2149`'s later verifier fixes at `avoid.rs:150` and `avoid.rs:170-174` (inherited modal axis and `iv.swing * reach` margin). Merge `#2149` first with a version above `72`. Then merge `upstream/main` into `issue/2088-shallow-floor-levels`. Then run the quick gate again.
2. **`crates/ui/src/egui_app/boundary.rs:305`, `crates/ui/src/avoid_viz.rs:326`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs:652`, and the PR body: Add before/after UI screenshots or drop the inherited UI diff after `#2149` merges.**
   Relative to `upstream/main`, this PR changes nine files under `crates/ui/`, including the `"Do not touch"` controls and viewport marks. The PR body includes no before/after screenshots. Refresh onto `upstream/main` after `#2149` merges, or link before/after screenshots from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch in the PR body. Do not commit screenshots to the PR branch.

Notes:
- Keep the `conflicts` label and draft status until the branch refreshes after `#2149` merges.
- The two `.nc` paths in the PR body (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/thread_g76_inch.nc` and `examples/first-continuous-4axis-part.nc`) exist on `upstream/main` and are not changed by this PR (`git diff --name-only upstream/main...review-2678 -- '*.nc' '*.cl' '*.png'` is empty).
- Inherited files `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, `crates/motion/src/machining3d/ladder.rs`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/boundary.rs` exceed 400 lines.
- This review did not run the full 611-step quick gate against `upstream/main`, the release gate, or ignored heavy tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
